[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-rc[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Ctrl+J / Ctrl+K Section Map[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Every successful Ctrl+J / Ctrl+K section jump in Obsidian briefly [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]shows a passive, beautiful Section Map in the jumping pane: the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]note's headings, where you are, where you came from, where the next[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]press lands, and when a press wrapped. The map is built from the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]same scanner and jump function the keys use, so it never disagrees [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]with them, and it never takes focus, keys, or clicks.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]property tests.[/#D7D7AF]
